newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-Israel's Orbotech a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Israel's Orbotech a buy.

text.p: Lehman Brothers has maintained Israel's Orbotech Ltd a buy in a report released on Sunday.

Analyst Theodor Kundtz said fourth-quarter results, due to be announced on February 18, were expected to be 28 percent higher than a year earlier at $0.37 a share. He forecast a 16 percent rise in earnings to $1.70 per share this year from an estimated $1.47 in 1996.
Kundtz gave Orbotech a one-year price target of $20 a share, compared with $16 47/64 on Friday.
Orbotech is the world's largest supplier of automated optical inspection (AOI) system for printed circuit boards (PCBs).
"Prospects for 1997 remain high, reflecting what we believe will be continued healthy demand for PCB AOI equipment and a pickup in Orbotech's flat panel display (FPD) AOI business," the report said.

The report came after Orbotech announced receiving $8 million order from Continental Circuits Corp. Orbotrech said 75 percent of the order was for delivery over the next eight months with the balance likely to be delivered by early 1998.
